<description>
Since commit 91f6d2bc8ff4d4cd1b86daa370ec9d2d9662394d in 2020, the wallet accepts and documents `conf_target` for the fee bump RPC.

So it seems time to cut the confusion and properly deprecate it with the next cycle.
</description>

<commits>
fa2ed3966f rpc: wallet: Schedule mixed-case confTarget option deprecation
</commits>

<files>
doc/release-notes-36488.md  +8/-0
src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp  +5/-1
test/functional/rpc_deprecated.py  +4/-0
test/functional/wallet_bumpfee.py  +1/-0

(test/bench/ci lines: 5)
</files>

<patch>
diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_bumpfee.py b/test/functional/wallet_bumpfee.py
index 01d931f46c..0daa415bbc 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_bumpfee.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_bumpfee.py
@@ -62,6 +62,7 @@ class BumpFeeTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.extra_args = [[
             "-mintxfee=0.00002",
             "-addresstype=bech32",
+            "-deprecatedrpc=confTarget",
         ] for i in range(self.num_nodes)]
 
     def skip_test_if_missing_module(self):
diff --git a/test/functional/rpc_deprecated.py b/test/functional/rpc_deprecated.py
index dd7f600247..15c9cc4d5d 100755
--- a/test/functional/rpc_deprecated.py
+++ b/test/functional/rpc_deprecated.py
@@ -40,6 +40,10 @@ class DeprecatedRpcTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
                 "fakeargument"
             )
 
+            self.log.info("Test confTarget option deprecation")
+            for rpc in (wallet.bumpfee, wallet.psbtbumpfee):
+                assert_raises_rpc_error(-32, "start the RPC server with the `-deprecatedrpc=confTarget`", rpc, "0" * 64, {"confTarget": 1})
+
 
 if __name__ == '__main__':
     DeprecatedRpcTest(__file__).main()
diff --git a/src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp b/src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp
index e228298c0c..d3eac9e2d7 100644
--- a/src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp
@@ -1057,7 +1057,7 @@ static RPCMethod bumpfee_helper(std::string method_name)
         UniValue options = request.params[1];
         RPCTypeCheckObj(options,
             {
-                {"confTarget", UniValueType(UniValue::VNUM)},
+                {"confTarget", UniValueType(UniValue::VNUM)}, // Deprecated, undocumented alias.
                 {"conf_target", UniValueType(UniValue::VNUM)},
                 {"fee_rate", UniValueType()}, // will be checked by AmountFromValue() in SetFeeEstimateMode()
                 {"replaceable", UniValueType(UniValue::VBOOL)},
@@ -1068,6 +1068,10 @@ static RPCMethod bumpfee_helper(std::string method_name)
             },
             true, true);
 
+        if (options.exists("confTarget") && !pwallet->chain().rpcEnableDeprecated("confTarget")) {
+            throw JSONRPCError(RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED, "DEPRECATION WARNING: Use conf_target (confTarget is deprecated and will be removed in the next release). To use it, start the RPC server with the `-deprecatedrpc=confTarget`.");
+        }
+
         if (options.exists("confTarget") && options.exists("conf_target")) {
             throw JSONRPCError(RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER, "confTarget and conf_target options should not both be set. Use conf_target (confTarget is deprecated).");
         }
diff --git a/doc/release-notes-36488.md b/doc/release-notes-36488.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..e61320fc71
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-36488.md
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+The deprecated `confTarget` option of the `bumpfee` and `psbtbumpfee` RPCs is
+now available only when the RPC server is started with
+`-deprecatedrpc=confTarget`.
+Use `conf_target` instead. The `confTarget` option will be removed in the next
+release.

</patch>
(Diff from merge base to head, smallest files first.)
